subject: Coordination: split air + truck shipments and on-site escort for Novum Health demo
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@apexexpo.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sara.lim@novumhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shipment split for Novum Health demo — air pallet + last-mile truck escort

Jonas,

Quick heads up on the Novum Health demo next week (Oct 2). The venue has a 10am load-in window but the main crate is currently booked on an international air leg that arrives 48 hours earlier. They want us to do a split delivery: air pallet to the advance warehouse (bonded) and local truck for the crate as it clears customs. The tricky bit: the crate is oversize and needs an on-site escort / pilot truck for the city permit.

Can Redwood confirm:
- Who will book the advance-warehouse inbound for the air pallet?
- Do you have a local escort vendor for the oversize crate (city permit + pilot truck)?
- Any customs paperwork we should prep to avoid a hold?

Attaching the preliminary manifest from the forwarder — file: apex_manifest_draft.pdf (see attachment).

Thanks,
Julia
Apex Expo Services
Ops Manager
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Julia Park <julia@apexexpo.com>, sara.lim@novumhealth.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment split for Novum Health demo — air pallet + last-mile truck escort

Julia — thanks for the heads up and the draft manifest. Looping in Grace (events ops) and Vanessa (EMEA/APAC freight experience) for routing/escort confirmation.

Quick answers:
- Redwood will book the advance inbound at the bonded warehouse this side; I’ll push the AWB and manifest to our customs broker this afternoon.
- For the oversize crate escort, we typically use Keller Logistics for permits and pilot trucks in this city; I’m pinging their ops contact for availability and permit lead time.
- Customs paperwork: proforma + commercial invoice + importer of record (Novum Health) + power of attorney for the broker. Grace — can you confirm we have Novum’s IOR details on file?

I’ll follow up with Keller and confirm ETA windows and whether we need to change the crate booking to an early morning slot to meet venue load-in.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Field Marketing Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marco Silva <marco@kellerlogistics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment split for Novum Health demo — air pallet + last-mile truck escort

Jonas / Grace —

Received the manifest. We can handle the bonded inbound for the air pallet and arrange the oversize escort, but two notes:
1) Permit lead time is 48–72 hours once we have exact crate dims, tare, and declared gross weight.
2) If the crate clears customs less than 4 hours before the venue slot, we’ll need to do a short-term holding at our city yard and schedule a first-available pilot truck. There’s a holiday the following Monday that tightens capacity (we recommend booking the escort now).

Can you confirm the finalized crate dimensions and whether Customs will release direct to consignee or to our yard?

Regards,
Marco Silva
Operations — Keller Logistics
attachments: booking_quote_7345.pdf
From: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
To: marco@kellerlogistics.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, julia@apexexpo.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment split for Novum Health demo — air pallet + last-mile truck escort

Marco / team —

Confirmed: Novum Health has provided IOR docs and customs broker contact. Final crate dims below (from our pack team):
- Crate: 18ft x 6ft x 7.5ft (length x width x height)
- Gross weight: 3,800 lbs
- Tare: 420 lbs

Customs broker (GlobalClear) will release to Keller’s yard if release happens after 6am on the day of load-in. We prefer Keller to hold and stage if the ETA is less than 6 hours before the venue slot.

Jonas — please proceed with booking the escort and the bonded warehouse inbound for the pallet. Julia — please confirm venue access point A vs B for pilot truck routing (A is tight on turning radius).

Thanks,
Grace
Senior Events Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: marco@kellerlogistics.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: julia@apexexpo.com, sara.lim@novumhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment split for Novum Health demo — air pallet + last-mile truck escort

Marco — booking confirmed and payment details sent to your billing (quote ref: KLR-7345). Attached: booking_manifest_7345.pdf and escort_confirmation_7345.pdf (pilot truck dated Oct 2, 06:00 pickup; permit applied).

Julia — venue access is POINT B (confirmed with venue). I added a note to the escort: extra space for a swing truck, avoid tight turn at A.

Grace — I’ve also uploaded the AWB and manifest to GlobalClear and CC’d their lead. If customs needs additional docs I’ll route immediately.

Next steps:
- Marco to confirm permit number and pilot truck plate by EOD Wednesday.
- Keller to advise if staging at yard is required (no later than 04:00 Oct 2).

— Jonas
From: Marco Silva <marco@kellerlogistics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, julia@apexexpo.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment split for Novum Health demo — air pallet + last-mile truck escort

Jonas / Grace / Julia —

Permit #PX-90822 issued. Pilot truck plate: 7HX-4Q2. We completed a short pre-load check at our yard this morning and took photos of the crate and blocking — attached: dock_photos_20260922.jpg. If the customs release comes through as planned we’ll collect at 05:30 on Oct 2 and be on-site at 06:00 for the pilot move.

Confirming KLR will hold the air pallet at the bonded facility (reference BOND-APX-112) and deliver direct to venue at 05:30 on Oct 2.

Regards,
Marco Silva
Keller Logistics — Operations
